specification.coefficient_convention: y=A*cos(m*phi)+B*sin(m*phi) implies positive-frequency C_m=(A-i*B)/2 and C_-m=conj(C_m)
specification.sample_interval: half-open [first WFDB beat, last WFDB beat)
specification.statistics: G=Psi^* W Psi; b=Psi^* W y
specification.weights: fixed raw identity weights, normalized once so sum_n w_n=1

result.coefficient_convention: y=A*cos(m*phi)+B*sin(m*phi) implies positive-frequency C_m=(A-i*B)/2 and C_-m=conj(C_m)

sufficient_statistics.definition: G=Psi^* W Psi; b=Psi^* W y

window.sample_selection: all half-open samples when span<=4096; otherwise a+floor(j*(b-a)/4096), j=0,...,4095

mathematical_contract.sample_payload: selected exact signed int64 digital values in deterministic order
mathematical_contract.solve: ACB verified linear solve followed by exact_binary64(H_hat_m) division
mathematical_contract.statistics: G=Psi^* W Psi and b=Psi^* W y accumulated in ACB

response_disks.radius_floor_semantics: when this certificate is used as numerical evidence, the declared frozen-sample-functional radius centered at this stored z_tilde must be no smaller than this published certified upper bound; the bound is sufficient and is not asserted to be the minimal true error
